summary: The cleanest names are still the ones with a full 9/9 or 8/9 F-score on nine computable tests, a top in-sector gross-profitability rank and operating cash flow well above net income: VRSN, FTDR and CARG lead, with DPZ, IDXX and TPR close behind. The main accounting concerns are DORM (CFO $113.6M against net income $204.2M), GRMN and ONC (amended 10-K/10-Q flags; GRMN's CFO is also below net income), and a group of fiscal years that are now more than a year old (CLX, TTEK, SMG, BLBD, SBH). CART and RRC are pending acquisition targets, so their fundamentals no longer drive the price. No lesson in learning.json names the Fundamentals Analyst and I have no graded calls yet; L3's label caveat matches what I flag below on sector labels.
